options.name: compact-output
help_lines: -c, --compact-output    print compact JSON

options.name: join-output
help_lines: -j, --join-output       raw output without result separators

options.name: logs
help_lines: -l, --logs              skip non-JSON lines (project extension)

options.name: stream
options.description: emit incremental path/leaf and container-end events
help_lines: --stream            emit path/value leaves and container-end events

options.name: stream-errors
options.description: emit parse-error events and resume at the next parser buffer
help_lines: --stream-errors     emit parse errors as stream events and recover

options.name: null-input
options.description: evaluate once with null; `input`/`inputs` can still read
help_lines: -n, --null-input        evaluate once with null; input/inputs may still read

options.name: slurp
options.description: collect input values in an array
help_lines: -s, --slurp             collect input values in an array

options.name: raw-output
help_lines: -r, --raw-output        print strings without JSON quotes

options.name: raw-input
options.description: read text lines; -Rs reads all text
help_lines: -R, --raw-input         read text lines; -Rs reads all text

options.name: sort-keys
help_lines: -S, --sort-keys         sort object keys recursively

options.name: exit-status
options.description: return 1 for false/null, 4 for no result
help_lines: -e, --exit-status       return 1 for false/null, 4 for no result

options.name: color-output
options.description: emit ANSI colors (JQ_COLORS customizes the palette)
help_lines: -C, --color-output      emit ANSI colors (JQ_COLORS customizes the palette)

options.name: monochrome-output
options.description: disable colors, including when -C is present
help_lines: -M, --monochrome-output disable colors, including when -C is present

options.name: from-file
options.description: read the first positional argument as a filter file
help_lines: -f, --from-file         read the first positional argument as a filter file
-f is a mode flag; other options may precede the filter filename. Use -- for a leading-dash filename.

options.name: indent
help_lines: --indent N         indentation -1 (tabs) through 7

options.name: tab
help_lines: --tab              indent with tabs

options.name: arg
help_lines: --arg NAME VALUE   bind a string variable

options.name: argjson
help_lines: --argjson NAME JSON bind a JSON variable

options.name: library-path
options.description: replace default module paths; repeated paths are searched in order
help_lines: -L DIRECTORY           search modules here; replaces the default paths

options.name: help
help_lines: --help      display this help and exit

options.name: version
help_lines: --version   display version and exit
